author: dollar-bill
text:
Desk notes — week of 10/19

Mon: Trimmed the listed asset manager basket by 10%; flows still ugly.
Tue: Kept TMC. Long 180,000 shares, average cost $39.10.
Wed: TMC Q3 letter: AUM down 3%, buyback paused. Stock barely moved.
Thu: Added to our regional bank shorts.
Fri: TMC closed at $41.65. Position up about $460K. Thinking about adding if it holds $40.
